headline: I Was Involved in a Hit and Run in San Diego—What Now?

publisher.name: Law Office of Angelo J. Reyes, APC

articleBody:
It's a frightening moment to realize you might have been involved in a hit and run. Maybe you didn't even know you hit something, or perhaps panic took over. Whatever the circumstances, the most important thing is to address the situation properly. Ignoring it won't make it go away; in fact, it can make things much worse, leading to more severe legal penalties.

First, resist the urge to speculate or make any statements to anyone, especially law enforcement, without legal guidance. Anything you say can and will be used against you. Your immediate priority should be to understand your rights and the potential implications of the situation. Hit and run charges in California can carry serious consequences, including hefty fines, points on your driving record, driver's license suspension, and even jail time, depending on the severity of the incident and if there were any injuries.

Next, discreetly seek professional legal counsel. A skilled attorney can assess the specifics of your case, explain the different types of hit and run charges, and help you understand the best course of action. They can act as a crucial buffer between you and law enforcement, protecting your rights and working to mitigate the damage. The Law Office of Angelo J. Reyes, APC has experience in these types of cases and can provide the expert defense you need in San Diego County, aiming for the best possible outcome given your situation.
